meta.name: Love Village
meta.description: Singles 35 and over of various backgrounds relocate to a house in the countryside for another chance at love. Will they find "the one" — or leave alone?

videos.title: A Mature Love Story that Begins at an Old House
videos.overview: A group of men and women looking for love move into a shared house in the countryside. First, they must work together to renovate and restore the house.

videos.title: One Pill or Two?
videos.overview: Hollywood reveals what he looks for in a perfect partner and has someone in mind — but he possibly goes a step too far.

videos.title: Thank You for Being Born
videos.overview: Tensions grow between Yukiemon and Hollywood. Totchan approaches Tabo. After a touching moment, Hollywood makes a big decision.

videos.title: I’m 120% Sure She’ll Say She Loves Me
videos.overview: Yukiemon must contemplate her future. Anchovy seems overly confident. A string of surprising news shakes up the group.

videos.title: Little and Big Hearts
videos.overview: With fresh faces in the mix, Tabo finally starts to get his game on. Totchan cooks her speciality dish and the reserved Sakechan starts to open up.

videos.title: Paper Doors, Thunder and Me in Love
videos.overview: Okayo reveals how she's been feeling but has a change of heart. Totchan makes her move. Anchovy remains in his own world.

videos.title: The Convenience Store Clerk and the Yoga Instructor
videos.overview: Okayo tries her best to win Junpei's attention. Minane struggles to fit in with the crowd. Yukorin suggests an idea to the women.

videos.title: Flowing Noodles
videos.overview: Tabo reflects on his first slip up. Okayo and Junpei work together on the women's bedroom — later, she makes her boldest move yet.

videos.title: Don’t Believe in Love
videos.overview: Junpei makes a final decision. Yukorin starts to show interest in a special someone. A new member joins and bonds with Minane.

videos.title: Enter the Great Detective
videos.overview: Sparks continue to fly between Tabo and Yukorin. Totchan's feelings for Sakechan grow stronger. Nakasan and Minane share a surprising past.

videos.title: A Comfortable 39°C Romance
videos.overview: Yukorin starts to second guess her feelings. Meanwhile, Totchan and Sakechan build a fire pit together and for a second, seem to grow closer.

videos.title: Be My Last Man
videos.overview: After receiving a heartwarming gift from Yukiemon, Totchan makes her final move. Sakechan contemplates his future outside of the village.

videos.title: An Inescapable Reality
videos.overview: Two new residents move in. Tabo plans a surprise for Yukorin, but tensions grow as they get to know each other on a deeper level.

videos.title: A Star Festival Gift
videos.overview: Anchovy thinks he may be stuck in another love triangle. It’s Yukorin's birthday, and Tabo finally reveals what he's been making.

videos.title: Overcoming His Wife’s Death
videos.overview: The next morning, Yukorin makes her decision. Anchovy confronts Yukiemon and has a revelation. Nakasan reveals his painful past.

videos.title: A  Rather Mature Love Triangle
videos.overview: A colorful new resident joins. Anchovy whips up a special treat for Tomochin. Minane and Numa P go fishing and find even more things in common

videos.title: The Love Bell
videos.overview: Bable plans a fun summertime event. Nakasan struggles to let go of his past. Numa P musters up the courage to approach Minane.

videos.title: The Black Swallowtail Butterfly’s Message
videos.overview: As Minane thinks long and hard about her future, the residents face their last day in the village. Later, the hosts receive some surprising news.

videos.title: Non-Glitz Romances Are Back!
videos.overview: Five women and four men arrive at a dilapidated house in Okinawa. As they settle in and start cleaning up, someone falls in love at first sight.

videos.title: Full-Body Hair Removal
videos.overview: Gitarin takes Pachi Yumi’s advice to heart. The residents bond over late-night drinks. Later, Tamifull reveals her preference for smooth-skinned men.

videos.title: This Is Hopeless
videos.overview: Chii leaves a tender note for her crush, and they grow closer through more nighttime chats. Manhattan tries to overcome a generation gap.

videos.title: A Second Serving
videos.overview: Gitarin musters up the courage to approach Chii, but his efforts seem to backfire. Thanks to a chat with Manhattan, Ayakan has an eye-opening revelation.

videos.title: Snot Bubble
videos.overview: Akipon shares the reason behind his apprehension about having kids. While the residents celebrate Chii's birthday, Gitarin is overcome with emotion.

videos.title: A Personal Comic Strip
videos.overview: Pachi Yumi and Sen-ne worry about their lack of romance. Meanwhile, Tamifull's comic strip inadvertently sparks romantic interest from someone.

videos.title: The Green Onion Incident
videos.overview: Captain's military ways rub a certain guitarist the wrong way. During lunch, a tiff over green onions creates a rift between two once-friendly residents.

videos.title: Flowers for the Hopeful
videos.overview: A surprise guest shows up ready to dish out a hearty meal and questionable advice. Manhattan's passionate dedication moves host Atsushi to tears.

videos.title: The Virgin Old Man
videos.overview: Tamifull must come to terms with her feelings. Nino opens up about her dry spell and the nickname her friends gave her. Captain finally makes a move.

videos.title: Gitarin's Great Gamble
videos.overview: Fired up by recent events, Makio decides to act. Sen-ne sets her sights on the new resident. Gitarin showers his crush with compliments and affection.

videos.title: Sato the Goat
videos.overview: Captain tries to start a morning routine with Nino. Sen-ne and Pachi Yumi step up their game. Later, the residents wake up to heartbreaking news.

videos.title: Love Fighter
videos.overview: To test her feelings, Sen-ne makes a daring request to all of the men. While Nino struggles to work with her crush, Makio takes a big step forward.

videos.title: Hearts Unleashed
videos.overview: Tamifull faces an important decision. The new resident's strong opinions trigger the others into action, turning a peaceful welcome party into chaos.

videos.title: Sweet Beans and Mochi
videos.overview: Tanasan spends more time with Pachi Yumi. Captain reveals his painful past. Ayakan tries to win her crush over by making his favorite sweet dish.

videos.title: Salute
videos.overview: After the residents give Captain a heartfelt salute, Aroma hosts a calligraphy class for everyone. Tanasan learns more about Pachi Yumi's colorful life.

videos.title: A Senior Gets Scolded
videos.overview: A new face joins, hoping for a fresh start. After Aroma lectures her, Sen-ne goes on the offensive. Tanasan's cheese-eating habits leave a bad impression.

videos.title: The Spy
videos.overview: The residents share their most gut-wrenching moments over breakfast. Later, Pachi Yumi volunteers to suss out Aroma's dating history for Sen-ne.

videos.title: The Miraculous Pachinko Machine
videos.overview: While Ayakan and Gitarin continue to practice their song, Aroma sorts out his feelings. Tanasan invites Pachi Yumi to make a pachinko machine together.

videos.title: Fifties and in Love
videos.overview: Encouraged by recent developments, Pachi Yumi takes a gamble. Later, Sen-ne gets fired up too. Will the older ladies find love or leave alone?

videos.title: Love is Just Great
videos.overview: Season Finale: Aroma candidly expresses his emotions. As the remaining residents spend their last days in the village, an unexpected confession emerges.

videos.title: Heartburning Romances are Back!
videos.overview: Before the Love Bell, a new group gathers near Mount Fuji. Two women zero in on surgeon Barron, igniting a love triangle with a combined age of 169.

videos.title: Boss and Underling
videos.overview: A birthday mishap forges a bond between Oyabun and Kathy. Romance stirs — but so does tension, as the women grow increasingly fed up with the men.

videos.title: Legs, or a Scent?
videos.overview: Phakchi's confidence nosedives. Oyabun's pursuit of a certain resident grows bolder. Later, a daring bedtime experiment raises the stakes for everyone.

videos.title: Everything Goes Ham
videos.overview: Barron's indifference weighs on Kathy. Shikun returns and confides in Muko. As Anchovy's fate is decided, the night descends into chaos.

videos.title: When Misunderstanding Turns to Certainty
videos.overview: Muko can't remember last night and scrambles to make amends. Kathy's makeover lesson lifts the mood. Later, a certain resident makes an unexpected move.

videos.title: I Can’t Watch
videos.overview: Muko refuses to give up on Shikun despite being pushed away. Kathy hits her 100km goal — and for the first time ever, resolves to make the first move.

videos.title: A Romance that Bloomed in 5 Seconds
videos.overview: A resident reaches a difficult decision. Just as Muko quietly makes up her own mind, two new residents arrive — and one of them falls hard within minutes.

videos.title: The 1980s Rules of Romance
videos.overview: A new resident arrives. Phakchi reaches into his '80s romance playbook. Enokano reveals a hidden health issue. Sparks fly during a silent weeding session.

videos.title: Just Grow Old, or Be Happy With Her?
videos.overview: Hakase opens up about a brush with death and the lessons he learned. Shikun returns eager for a reunion — only to discover nothing is as he left it.

videos.title: Hakase’s Kabedon
videos.overview: As Shikun shares the reality of his condition, Enokano's bombshell leaves a certain resident heartbroken. Hakase attempts his own original kabedon.

videos.title: Can I Bring Joy to the One I Love?
videos.overview: Shikun renovates the loft and makes a decision. Hakase can't sleep. That night, the two rivals clash over one question: who can make her happy?

videos.title: A Decision Made Together
videos.overview: Shikun's fate is decided on a rainy morning. As Hakase shares his anxiety, one love reaches its end — and a moment arrives that makes the show's history.
